findings.title: Service selects no pods
findings.cause: Service web selects pods with app=web,pod-template-hash=5d9f7c6b8d, and no pod in namespace kd-service-selects-pod-template-hash has those labels: pod-template-hash=5d9f7c6b8d is a label the Deployment controller, one value per ReplicaSet puts on the pods it creates, and it changes with each rollout, so a selector copied from a pod matches only that rollout's pods; the pods now carry pod-template-hash=696d644569

evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-service-selects-pod-template-hash -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'
kubectl get pods -n kd-service-selects-pod-template-hash -l app=web -L pod-template-hash

findings.fix: Remove pod-template-hash from the Service's selector and select the pods by the labels their template gives them (app=web).
